Separate Content Library — v4.10

The sidebar now includes two separate pages: Learning Resources retains the v4.8 page; Content Library contains independent files.

Format tabs

ALL | Videos | PPTx | Docx | Images

  • ALL: every content-library file, including videos, PPT/PPTX, DOCX and PNG/JPG/JPEG.
  • Videos: approved video files only; MP4 and WEBM are supported by default.
  • PPTx: PowerPoint files only.
  • Docx: Word documents only.
  • Images: PNG/JPG/JPEG only.

Tabs filter in place with counts. Search is applied within the chosen tab. Images and supported videos can be previewed; all formats retain their original downloadable bytes. Empty libraries and search results display clear messages.

Bulk upload

  1. Schoolnet Admin or a trainer with upload permission clicks Bulk upload files.
  2. Select Common library (Schoolnet Admin) or an authorized project.
  3. Choose multiple files directly. An Excel sheet is not required.
  4. Validate files: unsupported types, unapproved video extensions, empty files and duplicate file names are rejected.
  5. Save bulk upload. All files revalidate before saving. Storage/permission failures roll the upload back; existing content is retained.

Common files are visible across permitted library users; project-specific files remain within project scope. Content Library stores files independently and does not automatically assign them to a training plan or batch.

Learning Resources retained

The v4.8 Learning Resources view, upload-and-link workflow, Excel + files upload, repository controls, plan mappings and historical availability remain in place. The v4.9 plan-based Resource Library replacement has been removed from the active workspace. Existing project, training plan, batch, trainee, attendance, master, assessment, certificate and report functions remain included.

Validation

50 targeted non-browser assertions pass for all tabs and file categories, independent learning records, upload grants, project scope, bulk byte persistence, duplicates, validation, audits and storage rollback. Regression suites and syntax/static-page checks pass. Browser layout, actual browser IndexedDB, codecs and XLSX parsing remain unverified.
